sections.text: Protection
Technical Procedure
Introduction

RC91 is a single phase static 
over current relay with an inverse line characteristic the RC91 module is 
included in LZ 96 relay configuration (A36), this relay provides back-up 
directional ground over current (DGOC) protection (Device No.67G), this relay 
has a power supply module (NF 92) ,test unit (XX91).

The
first draft initialed by Eng. Mohamed Mostafa, and tested at 01/01/02, Samalout 500, 
 ME
Safety Precautions

items:
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes ..etc

Make sure CT secondary circuits are 
 shorted before the relay current circuits for test current injection.

sections.text:
Prior to starting testing procedures ensure 
the following steps

This procedure is used to 
 perform off load relay testing.

Check that the panel name plate 
 agrees with the EEC designation of the line that has been taken out of service 
 for maintenance.

Check there is no AC current 
 from CT by using clip-on ammeter

Check there is no AC voltage 
 from VT by using voltmeter.

Check all external connections 
 to the relay are in good condition and check that the terminal block wires are 
 tight.
